design.algorithm: DSAC actor + distributional twin quantile critic + CVaR policy objective + CQL regularization
design.scope: Alpha3 entry stack frozen. DSAC exit owner chooses hold-with-guard, market close, maker close, partial close, or TWAP-style reduce-only actions.
design.feature_design: Feature sweep uses Alpha3 exit-owner analysis: state16 raw, state16+topbase20, state16+base PLS8, and state16+topbase20+base PLS8.
design.limitations: No L2/orderbook/queue inputs or labels by request. Maker fills use existing OHLC immediate-limit proxy; partial/TWAP rewards are synthetic approximations from full-close DP targets.

reward_design.market_close_100: baseline immediate limit fallback target minus direct taker/urgency cost.
reward_design.maker_close_100: exit0/2/4 OHLC immediate-limit proxy targets minus maker offset risk cost.
reward_design.partial_close: 52% realized close value plus 48% hold continuation with MAE penalty.
reward_design.twap_maker2: 34% maker2 close value plus 66% hold continuation with time penalty.
reward_design.hold_with_guard: hold continuation penalized by exit advantage, giveback, and hold age.
